setup: Every case starts from its own empty data folder (LITTLEBUDDY_DATA_DIR = a new temp dir, absent profile.json = memory on, A40/REQ-036), real Bonsai, Wi-Fi off. 'say' = the lines are sent in one chat as the page sends them (POST /api/respond {line, history}, history = the earlier lines and replies of that chat). 'wait' = 30 s after the last reply (01 §1). 'restart' = stop the server, npm start again, new chat (history []). Every edit is made with the server stopped, in a text editor (here: write the bytes), then start and reload.
